item.title: My First Post
item.author: darkfeather0401@gmail.com (darkfeather)
item.description:
My First Post

Author: darkfeather(darkfeather0401@gmail.com)

Welcome to my blog, my first post.

After stumbling along the way, I finally got my blog built. Let me share some thoughts. AI is just too useful. For a complete beginner with zero programming background like me, I really couldn’t have built a personal blog on my own without the help of Teacher DeepSeek. From feeling dizzy and overwhelmed when I first looked at the tutorial, to gradually understanding the process (copying a pro’s webpage framework from Hugo and then quietly making it my own, and then deploying the webpage to GitHub so everyone could see it), and finally leaving the entire deployment part to Teacher D to teach me how to type cmd commands (but please forgive me, I really couldn’t understand it).

Published on 2026-09-13 at Welcome to my blog., last modified on 2026-09-13
